episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her journey of using YouTube as a powerful lead generation tool, highlighting the importance of consistency and perseverance. She discusses the challenges she faced and the systems she implemented to manage an increasing number of leads, offering valuable insights for agents looking to diversify their lead generation strategies.
